fixed_release_gates.unit: related-source-event-component; paired hierarchical seed and group bootstrap

limits: Development selection on all584 rows in12 related-source groups, seed42 only; every predeclared candidate is retained. This does not establish held-out confirmation or release quality.
Each candidate precision pair shares its own allocation. Different candidates ran on different allocations; these descriptive timing values are not a paired three-seed speed comparison.
External device/process and host values are sampled lower bounds. Incomplete host-PSS flags and absent/narrow-interval samples remain visible; none are imputed or repaired.
Process RSS/PSS does not measure unmapped filesystem page cache. Device memory and CUDA allocator peaks measure different scopes.
Peak intervals end at recorded reset boundaries. Loading excludes earlier source verification/setup; checkpoint_write requires checkpoint_complete immediately after checkpoint_begin.
Maximum configured length4096 is a limit, not an observed training-length claim. Eight processed temporal slots do not establish eight unique decoded source frames.
Actual checkpoint sizes come from the original filesystem analyzer; this projector verifies bound metadata/logs and does not read checkpoint tensor payloads.

selection_metadata_correction.scope: Selector alpha constants use the exact original integer32/64 JSON serialization. Original experiments, data, native overrides, strict equality, ranking and thresholds are unchanged.

selection_rule: Within each precision, minimize development supervised-token NLL among completed finite candidates with owned device-process sampled peak <=24GiB and development restricted-choice accuracy no more than1percentage point below that precision baseline candidate; tie by smaller peak then elapsed seconds. Selection does not imply quality-gate success.
